neighbours.label: ' f' / ' F' as a split-off word-initial piece of a longer word (f|ashions, f|itter, F|ights, F|ertility)
fire: The department store on the corner sells the latest fashions for teenagers.
A short walk every morning can help you become fitter and calmer.
Use a soap that Fights bacteria and keeps the skin clear.
The clinic publishes a newsletter called Fertility Today each spring.
Most of the boutiques in the old town stock summer fashions from Italy.
After a month of swimming she felt much fitter than she had in years.
The new spray Fights mould on bathroom tiles for up to six weeks.
Her paper appeared in Fertility and Sterility last November.
quiet: The department store on the corner sells the latest fabrics for curtains.
A short walk every morning can help you become fierce and calmer.
Use a soap that removes fungi and keeps the skin clear.
The clinic publishes a newsletter about fertile soil each spring.
Most of the boutiques in the old town stock summer fabrics from Italy.
After a month of swimming she felt much fiercer than she had in years.
The new spray kills fungi on bathroom tiles for up to six weeks.
Her paper appeared in a journal about fossils last November.

notes: Card: peaks on ' f' x12, ' F' x9, ' inf' x4 where the word was split. Tokenizer checked: fashions, fitter, Fights, Fertility split as ' f'/' F' + rest; quiet items use f-words that are single tokens (fabrics, fertile, fierce, fungi, ferment, fossils).
